thread:
Maria: Heads up — saw a ~12% drop in prompt cache hit-rate for model gpt-small-v2 on the /summarize route after the kernel-routing tweak last night. Token-saved rate down ~7k/hr. Grafana spike at 03:14 UTC. @Alex @Jamie any quick thoughts?
Alex: Oof. I updated kernel selection rules to prefer fused kernels for short sequences — maybe we changed latency distribution and batching?
Jamie: Could be. The new batching matrix reduces small-batch aggregation when latency variance is high. That might reduce prompt-prefix grouping and hurt cache locality.
Maria: Exactly my hunch — fewer prefixes getting coalesced into the same batch so KV hits drop.
InfraBot: Deploy 2026.03.18-kernel-select v1.9 rolled to canary at 02:50 UTC, promoted to prod 03:05 UTC. Change: prefer-fused=true, batch-window-ms=12 -> 8.
Kevin: Can someone paste the hit-rate query for the dashboard? I want to slice by customer and route.
Jamie: SQL I used in the panel: ```sql
SELECT
  model, route, tenant_id,
  avg(hit_rate) AS avg_hit_rate,
  sum(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved
FROM cache_metrics
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY model, route, tenant_id
ORDER BY avg_hit_rate DESC;
```
Dorothy: Quick check: top affected customers are cust-42 and cust-aws-logics, both heavy /summarize users. Their prefix entropy is low, so they rely on grouping.
Maria: Confirmed — cust-42 lost ~18% hit-rate, tokens_saved dropped ~15k in the last 4h.
Alex: Two levers: revert batch-window to 12ms, or add a heuristic to prefer prefix-key affinity when grouping. Reverting is faster but temporary.
SRE: Also seeing a minor bump in tail latency for canary hosts when fused kernels are used for long sequences — might be related.
Jamie: We can try a hybrid: keep prefer-fused but increase batch-window to 14ms for routes with high prefix reuse. Implement route-level overrides in batching config.
Kevin: How hard to gate by route? We already have per-route props in routing layer. Would need a new flag in batching engine to prefer-affinity for a route. Estimate: 2 dev days + 1 infra day to roll safely.
Maria: For observability, can we add a temporary panel: hit-rate delta pre/post deploy, per-model/per-route/per-tenant, and token-saved delta? Put a 1h and 24h comparison.
Jamie: Yep. I'll add a lightweight panel and a derived metric: hit_delta = hit_rate_now - hit_rate_24h_ago.
Maria: Thx. Also add a small alert: if hit_delta < -0.05 AND tokens_saved_drop > 2000 over 1h -> page.
InfraBot: Alert rule created: cache_hit_delta_drop (severity: P2).
Dorothy: Running an offline simulation now: replays from cust-42 traffic with both batching configs to estimate hit-rate change. Will have numbers in ~90m.
Alex: Meanwhile I can roll a canary with batch-window=14ms and prefer-affinity=true for /summarize only. Keep fused kernels on.
SRE: Schedule: canary -> monitor 30m -> scale to 10% -> monitor 2h -> ramp. Use the token-saved metric and tail latency dashboards.
Maria: Nice. After Dorothy's sim, we'll decide whether to keep the change or adopt the route override.
Kevin: One more ask: add kernel-selection tags to cache telemetry so we can correlate hit-rate by kernel (fused vs unfused). Even a single tag helps slice.
Jamie: Good call. I'll add kernel_type label to the metrics (values: fused, native).
Maria: Great. Thanks team — keep updates here. If anyone sees the alert fire, @SRE please escalate. :thumbsup:
Dorothy: Simulation done early: with batch-window=8ms we see -11% hit, with 14ms it's -2%. Pushing results to shared chart now: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/cache-batching-sim
Alex: Given that, I'll push the 14ms per-route override to canary in 10m.
SRE: Monitoring hooks added. Will report back after 2h window.
Maria: Excellent — mark this thread resolved once rollback/mitigation done or permanent fix merged.
